name: University of Calgary
header:
University of Calgary
Canada · Mathematics MSc (thesis) / Mathematics and Statistics PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 251-300. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Bachelor’s applicants should use the thesis MSc route; no direct PhD eligibility was established.
• January 15 is a standing deadline, not a verified 2027-specific announcement.
• CAD35,700 is a 2027-28 forecast; CAD34,000 is the actual 2026-27 international base, both gross before
tuition/fees.
• Do not recommend Matthew Greenberg for current number-theory supervision based on the stale area page.
• Historical GAC essay limits are preserved as planning context only and must be replaced with current portal
instructions before drafting.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle for the thesis MSc after a four-year UChicago mathematics bachelor’s, subject to a 3.0/4.0
GPA over the final two years and academic fit. The published PhD requirement is a relevant master’s; a
bachelor’s-only direct-PhD route was not established. International applicants are accepted. F-1 status is not
Canadian study authorization. A supervisor is needed by commencement, not necessarily before applying. [s1]
[s3] [s4] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose the funded thesis MSc rather than the unfunded course MSc. Contact possible supervisors with CV and
transcript; list names on the application. Obtain three referees’ consent, create an eID, complete/pay the
application, then use Student Centre for documents. Request an English exemption decision if relying on
UChicago. Apply separately for GAC once an applicant UCID is available. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s8] [s11]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Pre-application faculty contact is strongly advised with CV and transcript; name suitable supervisors on the
form. The central program page marks Clifton Cunningham as accepting inquiries. A supervision arrangement
is required by the start of study. Individual availability and MSc/PhD supervisory status must still be confirmed.
[s1] [s3] [s4]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Submit/pay first; then Student Centre provides supporting-document tasks and status. Referee invitations
follow submission. Contact admissions to correct a submitted application. Use the official university portal and
monitor it for offers; do not send final official records before requested. GAC is a separate Student Centre
award application available after a UCID is assigned. [s1] [s5] [s8] [s11]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Admission pages provide standing November 1/January 15 dates, without a Fall 2027 label. The funding policy
contains a genuine 2027-28 projection; the department’s exact table is 2026-27 only. GAC current deadlines
and writing fields need confirmation. [s1] [s9] [s10] [s11]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing annual calendar: opens November 1; complete application January 15 for fall entry, no extension.
These official math pages do not label this as January 15, 2027, so the 2027 date and closing time/time zone
require confirmation. No winter/spring admission competition is advertised. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Regular thesis support is considered with the complete January 15 admission application (standing date, not
independently confirmed for 2027). GAC opens November 1; the program sets an earlier internal deadline. The
GAC FAQ mentions a February 1 FGS deadline without a year. Obtain the mathematics internal 2027 GAC
deadline; do not substitute February 1 as the applicant deadline. [s1] [s11] [s12]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
All three admission reference forms and letters must be received by the standing January 15 completion
deadline. For GAC, both reports must arrive by its program deadline, even if the award form was submitted
earlier. Current-year times/time zones are unpublished. [s1] [s12]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Any required official English results are part of the January 15 complete-file deadline (standing). No GRE score
is required. Obtain the English exemption before relying on an incomplete score checklist. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s8]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All admission supporting items are due January 15 under the standing math rule. If admitted conditionally, final
official transcripts/degree confirmation are due on the individual offer’s date. GAC uses its separate program
deadline and requires registrar-issued transcripts, not student-account printouts. [s1] [s6] [s11]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal public mathematics acceptance date was established. The offer in Student Centre controls
acceptance and any final-document conditions; confirm funding acceptance dates with the program. [s6] [s8]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Science’s higher threshold applies: TOEFL taken before January 21, 2026: 97 with every section 23; tests
on/after that date: overall 5.0 and every section 5.0. Alternatives: IELTS 7.0 with each 6.5; CAEL 70/each 60;
PTE 76/each 70; Duolingo 135/each 125; Cambridge 180/each 175; Calgary ACC A− in each course. Official
results must come from the testing agency. [s7] [s8]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A graduate program director may exempt a completed bachelor’s of at least three years or graduate degree
taught AND examined in English at a WHED-listed English-language institution. A completed UChicago
bachelor’s appears to meet the substantive criterion (inference), but exemption remains discretionary; obtain
confirmation, especially if the degree is still in progress at application. F-1 status itself gives no exemption. [s8]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required: both central program profiles list no admission test scores. The public sources do not establish
whether unsolicited GRE results are accepted or considered. English testing is a separate requirement. [s3] [s4]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload records for every postsecondary institution, with grading scale, course weights and grades; include
available degree certificates and certified English translations where needed. One PDF per institution in the
application workflow. Initially upload copies; final official records are normally requested only after an offer,
sent directly by the issuing institution. GAC requires registrar-issued transcripts, dated in fall for current study
or after the final term for completed study, with grading legends. [s5] [s6] [s11]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course list is requested in the published math or central MSc/PhD checklists.
Transcript course records are required; portal-specific additional questions remain to be checked. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No separate course-description/syllabus upload is listed publicly. Do not assume an optional upload is
permitted; supply descriptions only if requested by the department. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three admission referees, with reference forms and letters on institutional letterhead. Central rules require
recommendations specific to the program and prohibit friends, relatives, colleagues or current graduate
students as referees; academic evaluators are preferred for recent graduates. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
GAC has TWO reference tasks. Admission letters may be reused if received within 11 months before the FGS
February 1 deadline; selecting an existing letter creates no new email. A new GAC-specific evaluation may
better address research record, preparation, communication and personal/research aptitude. Its two reports
are separate from the admission count of three. [s12]
What sends the invitation [Conflict]
Central admissions explicitly says referee invitations are emailed after the applicant submits. The math FAQ’s
shorter description associates the email with entering referee details; do not rely on entry alone to trigger it.
Submit early enough for referees to act. [s1] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, central admission instructions place invitations after application submission. New GAC referees instead
receive a message when the applicant uses Notify and can be invited before award submission. [s5] [s12]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Student Centre provides application/document status. A referee receives a submission confirmation; a letter
can remain pending if its final-submit step was missed. GAC sends receipt email to both applicant and referee
and lets the applicant view task status. [s1] [s12]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
A submitted admission application cannot be edited by the applicant; contact graduate admissions about
corrections. No current public rule establishes replacement of an already submitted admission letter or
cross-cycle reuse. GAC expressly permits eligible recent admission-letter reuse; an in-progress new-reference
task can be removed/re-entered and notified again, whereas post-submission changes require the awards
office. [s1] [s12]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Not listed as a required admissions upload. The department recommends sending a CV when approaching
potential supervisors. No admissions CV prompt, length or upload/link specification is public. [s1] [s3] [s4]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No statement of purpose is listed on the public admission checklist; central profiles list no special documents. A
portal-only statement prompt/length cannot be ruled out without the current form. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement is listed for admission. GAC assesses personal/interpersonal
qualities; historical scholarship fields are recorded separately below. [s3] [s4] [s14]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Identify intended supervisors/research fit in the application process. A standalone research-interest essay,
exact prompt, length and format are not publicly specified. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No admission research proposal is listed. A GAC research proposal is required within the scholarship workflow;
current field limits need checking in Student Centre. [s3] [s4] [s12]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Central MSc and PhD profiles explicitly list no work samples. No thesis/paper upload or link is requested
publicly. [s3] [s4]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate admissions publication list is listed. GAC asks about research contributions and publication status;
distinguish submitted, accepted and published work. Current upload-versus-link instructions are unverified. [s3]
[s4] [s12]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No standalone written mathematics-course list is listed; academic records supply courses and grades. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship essays [Prior cycle]
GAC requires a separate application. Historical November 2021 official workshop fields (faithful paraphrase;
NOT verified for 2027): research abstract 250 words; proposal 800; bibliography 1,000; presentations/research
contributions 1,000; leadership/interpersonal evidence 800; allowable interruptions 250; academic history and
up to ten awards. These were portal text tasks. Current prompts, limits and formatting must be confirmed
before drafting. Present the proposal for a broad academic audience. Evaluation weights are academic
achievement 40%, research potential 40%, personal/interpersonal qualities 20%. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s14]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
No additional admissions essay is publicly listed. Do not copy the 2021 GAC workshop’s Cumming School of
Medicine extra attachment into a mathematics application: it was faculty-specific. [s3] [s4] [s13]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Actual 2026-27 mathematics base: CAD 34,000 per year for international thesis MSc/PhD students (CAD 33,000
domestic), gross and including teaching/research components across the year; tuition and fees are paid from
it. The March 2026 Science policy explicitly PROJECTS a 2027-28 international base of CAD 35,700 (domestic
CAD 33,600); this is a forecast, not a fixed 2027 offer. Final annual minima use actual tuition/fees and are
announced at least two months before the funding year. Course-based MSc is unfunded. [s9] [s10] [s2]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Minimum-support commitment: thesis MSc two years; PhD four years, subject to eligibility and progress.
Extensions may be expected in appropriate circumstances but are not guaranteed. Normal PhD completion is
four years with a six-year maximum; these are not six years of guaranteed funding. [s2] [s4] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International full-time thesis students are included; the published base is higher to account for tuition. Fully
externally sponsored students are an exception. GAC has no overall citizenship restriction, but each award has

its own eligibility. University doctoral recruitment awards highlighted on the recruitment page are domestic
and should not be assumed available based on US F-1 status. [s1] [s9] [s11] [s16]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time active registration, satisfactory annual progress, GPA at least 3.0 and no course below B−, plus
assigned assistantship duties. The math minimum may include up to 2.5 GAT units annually; refusing available
work can reduce support. Awards can replace portions of departmental/TA funding. From 2027-28 the general
scholarship rule preserves the base plus the first CAD 3,000 and 15% of the remaining award, subject to
award-specific exceptions and the total-award floor; consult the final offer for exact composition. [s9] [s10]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate regular thesis-stipend application is identified beyond admission. GAC requires a separate Student
Centre form, award selection, transcripts and two reference tasks. International students are encouraged to
seek appropriate home-country/external awards; do not assume eligibility for citizenship-restricted Canadian
awards. [s1] [s9] [s11]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
GAC awards range from CAD 700 to CAD 36,000 depending on award; eligibility must be met by first payment.
Department examples include Henrietta Weyland doctoral support and the Eric Milner award for full-time thesis
MSc/PhD work and mathematical sharing. Department awards and outside scholarships have individual criteria;
scholarship income is not necessarily added in full to the base. [s11] [s15] [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 145 international application fee; CAD 125 Canadian citizens/permanent residents. Pay through the online
application; fee is separate from subsequent tuition. [s5] [s6]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
A mathematics-specific fee-waiver entitlement or public request process was not found in the reviewed
department, central application or calendar instructions. Ask graduate admissions before paying if seeking
hardship relief; do not assume a waiver based on US F-1 status. [s1] [s5] [s6]

text:
University of Calgary
Canada · Mathematics MSc (thesis) / Mathematics and Statistics PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 251-300. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Bachelor’s applicants should use the thesis MSc route; no direct PhD eligibility was established.
• January 15 is a standing deadline, not a verified 2027-specific announcement.
• CAD35,700 is a 2027-28 forecast; CAD34,000 is the actual 2026-27 international base, both gross before
tuition/fees.
• Do not recommend Matthew Greenberg for current number-theory supervision based on the stale area page.
• Historical GAC essay limits are preserved as planning context only and must be replaced with current portal
instructions before drafting.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle for the thesis MSc after a four-year UChicago mathematics bachelor’s, subject to a 3.0/4.0
GPA over the final two years and academic fit. The published PhD requirement is a relevant master’s; a
bachelor’s-only direct-PhD route was not established. International applicants are accepted. F-1 status is not
Canadian study authorization. A supervisor is needed by commencement, not necessarily before applying. [s1]
[s3] [s4] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose the funded thesis MSc rather than the unfunded course MSc. Contact possible supervisors with CV and
transcript; list names on the application. Obtain three referees’ consent, create an eID, complete/pay the
application, then use Student Centre for documents. Request an English exemption decision if relying on
UChicago. Apply separately for GAC once an applicant UCID is available. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s8] [s11]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Pre-application faculty contact is strongly advised with CV and transcript; name suitable supervisors on the
form. The central program page marks Clifton Cunningham as accepting inquiries. A supervision arrangement
is required by the start of study. Individual availability and MSc/PhD supervisory status must still be confirmed.
[s1] [s3] [s4]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Submit/pay first; then Student Centre provides supporting-document tasks and status. Referee invitations
follow submission. Contact admissions to correct a submitted application. Use the official university portal and
monitor it for offers; do not send final official records before requested. GAC is a separate Student Centre
award application available after a UCID is assigned. [s1] [s5] [s8] [s11]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Admission pages provide standing November 1/January 15 dates, without a Fall 2027 label. The funding policy
contains a genuine 2027-28 projection; the department’s exact table is 2026-27 only. GAC current deadlines
and writing fields need confirmation. [s1] [s9] [s10] [s11]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing annual calendar: opens November 1; complete application January 15 for fall entry, no extension.
These official math pages do not label this as January 15, 2027, so the 2027 date and closing time/time zone
require confirmation. No winter/spring admission competition is advertised. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Regular thesis support is considered with the complete January 15 admission application (standing date, not
independently confirmed for 2027). GAC opens November 1; the program sets an earlier internal deadline. The
GAC FAQ mentions a February 1 FGS deadline without a year. Obtain the mathematics internal 2027 GAC
deadline; do not substitute February 1 as the applicant deadline. [s1] [s11] [s12]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
All three admission reference forms and letters must be received by the standing January 15 completion
deadline. For GAC, both reports must arrive by its program deadline, even if the award form was submitted
earlier. Current-year times/time zones are unpublished. [s1] [s12]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Any required official English results are part of the January 15 complete-file deadline (standing). No GRE score
is required. Obtain the English exemption before relying on an incomplete score checklist. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s8]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All admission supporting items are due January 15 under the standing math rule. If admitted conditionally, final
official transcripts/degree confirmation are due on the individual offer’s date. GAC uses its separate program
deadline and requires registrar-issued transcripts, not student-account printouts. [s1] [s6] [s11]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal public mathematics acceptance date was established. The offer in Student Centre controls
acceptance and any final-document conditions; confirm funding acceptance dates with the program. [s6] [s8]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Science’s higher threshold applies: TOEFL taken before January 21, 2026: 97 with every section 23; tests
on/after that date: overall 5.0 and every section 5.0. Alternatives: IELTS 7.0 with each 6.5; CAEL 70/each 60;
PTE 76/each 70; Duolingo 135/each 125; Cambridge 180/each 175; Calgary ACC A− in each course. Official
results must come from the testing agency. [s7] [s8]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A graduate program director may exempt a completed bachelor’s of at least three years or graduate degree
taught AND examined in English at a WHED-listed English-language institution. A completed UChicago
bachelor’s appears to meet the substantive criterion (inference), but exemption remains discretionary; obtain
confirmation, especially if the degree is still in progress at application. F-1 status itself gives no exemption. [s8]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required: both central program profiles list no admission test scores. The public sources do not establish
whether unsolicited GRE results are accepted or considered. English testing is a separate requirement. [s3] [s4]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload records for every postsecondary institution, with grading scale, course weights and grades; include
available degree certificates and certified English translations where needed. One PDF per institution in the
application workflow. Initially upload copies; final official records are normally requested only after an offer,
sent directly by the issuing institution. GAC requires registrar-issued transcripts, dated in fall for current study
or after the final term for completed study, with grading legends. [s5] [s6] [s11]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course list is requested in the published math or central MSc/PhD checklists.
Transcript course records are required; portal-specific additional questions remain to be checked. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No separate course-description/syllabus upload is listed publicly. Do not assume an optional upload is
permitted; supply descriptions only if requested by the department. [s1] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three admission referees, with reference forms and letters on institutional letterhead. Central rules require
recommendations specific to the program and prohibit friends, relatives, colleagues or current graduate
students as referees; academic evaluators are preferred for recent graduates. [s1] [s3] [s4] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
GAC has TWO reference tasks. Admission letters may be reused if received within 11 months before the FGS
February 1 deadline; selecting an existing letter creates no new email. A new GAC-specific evaluation may
better address research record, preparation, communication and personal/research aptitude. Its two reports
are separate from the admission count of three. [s12]
What sends the invitation [Conflict]
Central admissions explicitly says referee invitations are emailed after the applicant submits. The math FAQ’s
shorter description associates the email with entering referee details; do not rely on entry alone to trigger it.
Submit early enough for referees to act. [s1] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, central admission instructions place invitations after application submission. New GAC referees instead
receive a message when the applicant uses Notify and can be invited before award submission. [s5] [s12]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Student Centre provides application/document status. A referee receives a submission confirmation; a letter
can remain pending if its final-submit step was missed. GAC sends receipt email to both applicant and referee
and lets the applicant view task status. [s1] [s12]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
A submitted admission application cannot be edited by the applicant; contact graduate admissions about
corrections. No current public rule establishes replacement of an already submitted admission letter or
cross-cycle reuse. GAC expressly permits eligible recent admission-letter reuse; an in-progress new-reference
task can be removed/re-entered and notified again, whereas post-submission changes require the awards
office. [s1] [s12]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Not listed as a required admissions upload. The department recommends sending a CV when approaching
potential supervisors. No admissions CV prompt, length or upload/link specification is public. [s1] [s3] [s4]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No statement of purpose is listed on the public admission checklist; central profiles list no special documents. A
portal-only statement prompt/length cannot be ruled out without the current form. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement is listed for admission. GAC assesses personal/interpersonal
qualities; historical scholarship fields are recorded separately below. [s3] [s4] [s14]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Identify intended supervisors/research fit in the application process. A standalone research-interest essay,
exact prompt, length and format are not publicly specified. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No admission research proposal is listed. A GAC research proposal is required within the scholarship workflow;
current field limits need checking in Student Centre. [s3] [s4] [s12]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Central MSc and PhD profiles explicitly list no work samples. No thesis/paper upload or link is requested
publicly. [s3] [s4]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate admissions publication list is listed. GAC asks about research contributions and publication status;
distinguish submitted, accepted and published work. Current upload-versus-link instructions are unverified. [s3]
[s4] [s12]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No standalone written mathematics-course list is listed; academic records supply courses and grades. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship essays [Prior cycle]
GAC requires a separate application. Historical November 2021 official workshop fields (faithful paraphrase;
NOT verified for 2027): research abstract 250 words; proposal 800; bibliography 1,000; presentations/research
contributions 1,000; leadership/interpersonal evidence 800; allowable interruptions 250; academic history and
up to ten awards. These were portal text tasks. Current prompts, limits and formatting must be confirmed
before drafting. Present the proposal for a broad academic audience. Evaluation weights are academic
achievement 40%, research potential 40%, personal/interpersonal qualities 20%. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s14]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
No additional admissions essay is publicly listed. Do not copy the 2021 GAC workshop’s Cumming School of
Medicine extra attachment into a mathematics application: it was faculty-specific. [s3] [s4] [s13]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Actual 2026-27 mathematics base: CAD 34,000 per year for international thesis MSc/PhD students (CAD 33,000
domestic), gross and including teaching/research components across the year; tuition and fees are paid from
it. The March 2026 Science policy explicitly PROJECTS a 2027-28 international base of CAD 35,700 (domestic
CAD 33,600); this is a forecast, not a fixed 2027 offer. Final annual minima use actual tuition/fees and are
announced at least two months before the funding year. Course-based MSc is unfunded. [s9] [s10] [s2]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Minimum-support commitment: thesis MSc two years; PhD four years, subject to eligibility and progress.
Extensions may be expected in appropriate circumstances but are not guaranteed. Normal PhD completion is
four years with a six-year maximum; these are not six years of guaranteed funding. [s2] [s4] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International full-time thesis students are included; the published base is higher to account for tuition. Fully
externally sponsored students are an exception. GAC has no overall citizenship restriction, but each award has

its own eligibility. University doctoral recruitment awards highlighted on the recruitment page are domestic
and should not be assumed available based on US F-1 status. [s1] [s9] [s11] [s16]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time active registration, satisfactory annual progress, GPA at least 3.0 and no course below B−, plus
assigned assistantship duties. The math minimum may include up to 2.5 GAT units annually; refusing available
work can reduce support. Awards can replace portions of departmental/TA funding. From 2027-28 the general
scholarship rule preserves the base plus the first CAD 3,000 and 15% of the remaining award, subject to
award-specific exceptions and the total-award floor; consult the final offer for exact composition. [s9] [s10]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate regular thesis-stipend application is identified beyond admission. GAC requires a separate Student
Centre form, award selection, transcripts and two reference tasks. International students are encouraged to
seek appropriate home-country/external awards; do not assume eligibility for citizenship-restricted Canadian
awards. [s1] [s9] [s11]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
GAC awards range from CAD 700 to CAD 36,000 depending on award; eligibility must be met by first payment.
Department examples include Henrietta Weyland doctoral support and the Eric Milner award for full-time thesis
MSc/PhD work and mathematical sharing. Department awards and outside scholarships have individual criteria;
scholarship income is not necessarily added in full to the base. [s11] [s15] [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 145 international application fee; CAD 125 Canadian citizens/permanent residents. Pay through the online
application; fee is separate from subsequent tuition. [s5] [s6]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
A mathematics-specific fee-waiver entitlement or public request process was not found in the reviewed
department, central application or calendar instructions. Ask graduate admissions before paying if seeking
hardship relief; do not assume a waiver based on US F-1 status. [s1] [s5] [s6]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Use Science’s higher English test minimum over the generic graduate-school minimum. Central admissions is
more explicit than the math FAQ about invitation timing. Funding projections must not be substituted for fixed
offers. Research-area pages still place Matthew Greenberg in number theory, but his current supervisor page
lists statistics/data science/machine learning and his personal page says he has left number theory. Nguyen’s
dated personal page reports promotion to professor in July 2025 although a directory still says associate. [s1]
[s5] [s7] [s8] [s9] [s10] [s17] [s21] [s22] [s29] [s30]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm January 15, 2027 and its time zone; mathematics GAC internal deadline and current essay limits;
discretionary English waiver for UChicago if not yet graduated; current admission-letter replacement/reuse
